summary: Kustom Entertainment filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its asset sale to Cycurion, Inc. on August 3, 2026, under a June 24, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement as amended July 23, 2026. Consideration comprises $1.25M cash, a $4.25M secured promissory note, up to $1M earnout, and $600,000 of Series H convertible preferred stock (replacing cancelled warrants). The sale covers the video-solutions division, with the note secured by the acquired assets. Registration rights were granted for the preferred shares. What to watch: earnout achievement and collection risk on the seller-financed note; the preferred stock's conversion terms may affect buyer's equity.
